Tent Rentals in Barrington, Nova Scotia

Nova Kingdom Rentals offers tent rentals in Barrington, Nova Scotia — serving the lobster capital of Canada and surrounding shore communities. Choose the 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent at $100 self-serve or $150 with setup and takedown (weight bags included), or the 20x20 Pole Tent at $300 self-serve or $400 with setup and takedown for full dining and seating coverage. Both are open-sided canopy tents, not enclosed event tents. The 20x20 requires a stakeable grass surface with stakes and guy ropes. Tents must stay anchored at all times and are not for use in high winds, storms, or unsafe weather.

Barrington is part of our core South Shore service area, close to our Bridgewater base. The first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Availability, delivery, setup suitability, and final pricing are confirmed manually for every tent booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does tent rental cost in Barrington?
The 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent is $100 self-serve or $150 with setup and takedown. The 20x20 Pole Tent is $300 self-serve or $400 with setup and takedown. The first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Final pricing for Barrington is confirmed manually.
Do you deliver tents to Barrington?
Yes. The first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Delivery, setup suitability, and availability for Barrington are confirmed manually before booking.
What surface do the tents need?
The 10x10 pop-up comes with weight bags and suits most flat, clear areas. The 20x20 pole tent uses stakes and guy ropes, so it needs a stakeable grass surface with clear space around the perimeter. Neither tent can be used in high winds, storms, or unsafe weather, and both must stay anchored at all times.
Can I add tables and chairs to a tent rental in Barrington?
Yes. Black padded folding chairs are $3 each and 6 ft tables start at $8 each. Add them to any Barrington tent booking, or combine tents with inflatables, lawn games, and the 360 Video Booth.
